result.brief: 提出算子错配对比学习（OMC），以“有效但算子错误”的未来轨迹作语义硬负样本，并配套世界相对一致性评测协议，可作为附加于现有世界模型表征的轨迹一致性打分器。
result.reason: Proposes contrastive learning over world-model trajectory representations with operator-mismatch hard negatives and a world-relative coherence evaluation protocol, directly contributing to world-model representation learning.
